purpose: Select one factorized five-coordinate plant mapping from a finite declared family before opening Option E confirmation points.

finite_family.enumeration_order: lexicographic product in the field order shown; lower ordinal breaks complete ties

target_selection_per_candidate.cost: sum of squared relative F1/F2/F3 error to the existing canonical reference
target_selection_per_candidate.uniqueness: a design motor point selected for an earlier vowel is ineligible
target_selection_per_candidate.design_valid_target: nearest canonical identity matches and relative formant RMSE is at most 0.25
target_selection_per_candidate.neighborhood: center plus and minus 0.04 on each motor axis, clipped to bounds
target_selection_per_candidate.valid_neighbor: nearest canonical identity matches and relative formant RMSE is at most 0.30

selection_key: maximum number of design-valid vowel targets
maximum minimum valid-neighbor fraction across vowels
minimum maximum target relative formant RMSE
minimum mean target relative formant RMSE
stop_rule: The selected mapping may be frozen into a separate confirmation preregistration. No coefficient may be changed after confirmation indices are opened.
